corpus_build_provenance.filter_definition: keep an entry iff conversations[0]['from'] in {'human','user'} and conversations[0]['value'], after str.strip(), is a non-empty string -- a validity predicate only. No exclusion by length or content (WEEK2_PLAN.md §3.4: 'may NOT remove valid prompts to shape the spread').
corpus_build_provenance.prompt_len_definition: char count of conversations[0]['value'] after strip(); token count is a Week 3 revisit (WEEK2_PLAN.md §3.4)
corpus_build_provenance.note: with-replacement i.i.d. draws happen at schedule-materialization time via a separate corpus_rng (WEEK2_PLAN.md §3.2/§3.4); this seed only controls which prompts made it into the pinned subset, not which are drawn from it at runtime.

provenance.note: Natural-random secondary curve (R4 README R11). Realism validation only: its points must never be pooled with, or substituted for, controlled headline points.
